documents.title: ARM long-running operations
documents.selectionRationale: Names the emitted Azure-AsyncOperation, Location, and Retry-After LRO headers and covers ARM PATCH LROs.

guidance.excerpt: For PATCH operations, long-running operation headers appear in the 202 Accepted response. Each header model has a FinalResult parameter, and that value must match what the operation actually returns.

ArmResourcePatchAsync and ArmCustomPatchAsync use ArmLroLocationHeader by default with the resource as the final result; ArmCombinedLroHeaders may be used to return both Azure-AsyncOperation and Location.

documents.title: Evolving APIs
documents.selectionRationale: Directly covers evolving an existing ARM API with versioning decorators for added operations and models.

guidance.excerpt: Add an ARM operation in a later API version by applying @added(Versions.v2) to the operation in an @armResourceOperations interface.
The @added decorator introduces models, properties, or operations in the specified version and all subsequent versions.
